entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF886753.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the AeroSafe helmet. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference. The helmet itself seems fine, but the color isn't quite what I expected from the website photos. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.
I understand. Getting the right color is important, especially for visibility and safety. Let me just check the delivery date. It looks like it was delivered five days ago, on January 17th.
Okay, great. Since it's a standard item, it falls within our 10-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right now.

That's excellent, thank you. Now, since I'm just going to be buying another helmet from you in a different color, and to save me the trouble of a separate transaction, would it be possible to get a small discount code or maybe free expedited shipping on the new one?

I'm happy we can process the return for you, Alex. I understand your request, but our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on exchanges or returns related to preference. Once the refund is processed, you'll be able to place a new order at your convenience.
I see. Well, it was worth asking. As long as the return is approved, that's the main thing. Please go ahead and send that label.

Of course. I've just sent the label to the email on file, a-smith@email.com. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
